claims.evidence: No brand, part number, or vehicle-specific markings are visible on the casing in any photo; only a generic white parts tag.
Nothing in the images identifies engine fitment; this is a verbal claim only.
No shipping label, import documentation, or country-of-origin marking shown in photos.
No test bench, video of operation, or diagnostic readout is shown; photos are static shots on the ground.
Noise cannot be assessed from still photos; would require audio/video of unit running.
No odometer, vehicle history, or donor-car documentation visible.
Casing is dirty/oily in photos; no close-up of bolt/seal integrity or tamper marks to confirm or deny this.

risks.risk: Internal gear/clutch/seal wear not assessable from exterior photos
risks.proof: Video of unit on a bench test showing smooth gear engagement and shifting through all ranges
Close-up photo/video of fluid pan, drain plug, and a sample of transmission fluid color

risks.risk: Compatibility with buyer's specific Ford Fusion variant/engine
risks.proof: Clear photo of part/casting number matched against buyer's VIN or engine code
risks.if_unproven: priced as unconfirmed fitment, buyer bears compatibility risk

risks.risk: Missing components (sensors, mounts, bolts, torque converter bolts)
risks.proof: Full-coverage photos of all mounting points, connectors, and sensor ports
risks.if_unproven: priced as incomplete unit until shown otherwise

risks.risk: Mileage/usage history unverifiable, 'low mileage' claim unsupported
risks.proof: Import/donor vehicle documentation or dealer paperwork from Belgium

risks.risk: Unit may have been previously opened/repaired despite claim
risks.proof: Close-up of casing bolts/seals showing factory-original torque marks or seals, untouched paint

proof_requests: Video of the transmission running on a test bench or installed, showing smooth shifting and no knocking/grinding sound
Close-up photo of casting/part number for model verification
Photo of fluid condition (color, smell description) and any pan/seal leaks
Full set of photos showing all sensor connectors, mounts, and bolts present
Any import/donor documentation from Belgium supporting mileage and origin claims
Close-up of casing bolts/seals to confirm 'never opened' claim
response.reason: The witness confirms this is a genuine used automatic transmission assembly, so it can be priced at worst case (untested, unconfirmed fitment, unverified origin/mileage) pending the requested proofs that could raise the price.
